review.review: The Mage died while starving after missing-exit exploration stalled. The initiating transition was decision 4645: its search kept health at 80/80 but made the hero hungry (accepted transition, line 13204). Eight searches had already been used. The regular policy lowers its total search ceiling from 40 to 8 when hungry (tools/survival_policy.py:1096-1102; tools/mage_policy.py:760-779). At decision 4646, lines 13205-13206, exploration reported no reachable exit, frontier or unopened door and fallback began waiting. The 120 unvisited reachable cells were not necessarily new viewing frontiers. The clock continued advancing; this was not an execution freeze. Later combat and healing interrupted the fallback, so nearby enemies cannot be assigned the final kill. Decision 5799, line 16656, records a starving hero falling from 1 HP to zero during a wait, without a visible hostile or warning. Complete source browsing resolves the selecting-chain gap: the search gate leads through tools/until_death.py:13 and tools/continuation.py:14 to best-effort waiting. No patch or new regression is proposed: raising the ceiling alone would not establish a safe replacement. A repair needs a validated remaining search target, approach/return route and hunger-cost admission under current threat memory and existing hazard, mapping and boss-floor rules. Remaining wall hypotheses and carried levitation do not prove an exit location or a safe protected crossing. Unknown potions and post-death item revelations supply no pre-death justification. An isolated reduced diagnostic reproduces the eight-search hunger gate, but does not certify a replacement. The unchanged Python suite passed 1,593 tests with four skips.
review.learnings: Distinguish exhausted ordinary frontiers from a verified completed floor. Investigate resource-funded missing-exit search admission when hunger reduces a cumulative search ceiling. Validate the actual safe route and work budget before changing admission; further searching is not proof of finding the exit. Preserve mandatory progression pickups, hazard exclusions and honest potion-effect receipts.
